name: print-social-story-futuristic-blue-purple-triangle-mountain
title: Futuristic blue/purple story with triangle-mountain motif
whatItIs: A vertical story template on a deep blue-to-purple gradient, centered on a glowing triangular mountain/arrow shape built from overlapping translucent planes, framed by a rounded outline border and 'Trendy Futuristic' headline.
whatItMeans: An upward-pointing faceted triangle formed from glowing translucent planes reads as both 'mountain' and 'arrow/growth,' giving an abstract geometric story template a sense of ascent and progress.
techniques: build a central icon shape from several overlapping translucent triangular planes
frame the whole story in a soft rounded outline border to separate it from the feed
add a scattering of small glowing dots as ambient sparkle in negative space

vocabulary.definition: a 3D-suggestive shape built from multiple flat overlapping surfaces, common in geometric brand marks
